name: controle-tv
description: PWA Controle TV com front-end modular, back-end Firebase e Local Bridge opcional.

scripts.build: node scripts/check-frontend-modules.js && npm run build --prefix functions && npm run build --prefix local-bridge
scripts.test: node --test "tests/**/*.test.js" && npm run test --prefix functions && npm run test --prefix local-bridge
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-frontend-modules.js && npm run lint --prefix functions && npm run lint --prefix local-bridge
